Welcome to Serenity by the Sea! Located just 0.6 miles from Inlet Beach, one of the area's largest and most pristine public beaches, our home is the perfect location for your next unforgettable vacation. You’ll be right down the street from the lively 30Avenue Pavilions, where you can explore a variety of dining, shopping and entertainment options. Plus, the charming Rosemary Beach Town Center and the start of scenic 30A are only minutes away.

Our Three-Story home is loaded with extras and comfortably accommodates up to 8 guests. We provide amenities like Bikes, BBQ Grill, Beach Gear, and more to make your vacation as stress-free and relaxing as possible.

🛏️ Third Floor Loft Area with 4 Bunk Beds
🌴Large Second Level Outdoor Deck
🚲Three Cruiser Bikes
🏖️Complimentary Beach Gear and Beach Towels
🎲Board Games and Books
🍳Well-stocked kitchen
🌭BBQ Grill
📺Mounted Smart TVs
☕Keurig and Drip coffeemaker
🚗Two Parking Spaces
🧴Starter kits of shampoo, conditioner and soap
👶Baby Gear: Baby Gates, Pack n' Play & High Chair
⭐High-quality bed Linens
⭐High-quality towels
⭐Premium Comfort Mattresses/Beds
⭐Fast and complimentary WIFI

IDEALLY LOCATED
Next to the start of 30A Scenic Highway, 30Avenue Pavilions and Inlet Beach, our home is the perfect location to enjoy beach time, shopping, award-winning dining, and lots of outdoor recreation. Rosemary Town Center is a quick bike ride away through a brand-new pedestrian underpass just minutes from our home. Kayak, paddleboard, or walk the nature trails at Camp Helen State Park just a few minutes away. Panama City is 9 miles away where you can reserve a guided dolphin tour, ride the Ferris Wheel at Pier Park, try out an Escape Room, and much more!
- Less than 2 miles to the grocery store and Watersound Town Center
- Walk or Bike to 30 Avenue Restaurants and Shops
- Close to the towns of Rosemary Beach, Alyce Beach, Seaside, Grayton Beach, Seagrove and more!
- 20 minutes to Panama City Beach Pier Park, snorkel and dolphin tours, cruises to Shell Island, fishing expeditions and much more.

LET US HELP YOU PLAN THE PERFECT FAMILY VACATION!
We will send you a list of our area recommendations after booking to help with your vacation planning. We are also happy to answer any questions you may have about our home or the area!

ADDITIONAL INFO:
- No parties are allowed at this home.
- Rental agreement between the guest and owner of the property will be required. Per our rental insurance, the person who signs our rental agreement must be 25 years or older and stay at the property.
- A $300 security deposit will be collected the day before arrival and refunded four days after departure
- Owner/manager may request drivers license off AirBnb platform for liability purposes.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

gallery.name: Welcome to Serenity by the Sea! We’re thrilled to offer you a relaxing retreat just minutes from the stunning Gulf Coast. Whether you’re here for the beach, local dining, or simply to relax, our home provides the perfect base for an unforgettable stay!
Enjoy beach days and sunset views from your private, stylish deck retreat!
Known for it's bright blue waters and pristine white sand, Inlet Beach was named a "beach that looks like the Caribbean" by Southern Living...and it's just .6 miles from our home!
Whether you're looking for extra sleeping space or a fun place to hang out, our 3rd Floor Bedroom/Loft area is the perfect spot for your family or friends.

Prepare delicious meals and enjoy quality time with family in our spacious, well-equipped kitchen, featuring modern appliances and everything you need for a seamless cooking experience. We have a Keurig and drip coffee maker available.
Tour the area on 4 cruiser bikes. Ride down to Inlet Beach or Scenic 30a just minutes away! A 19-mile bike path runs along 30A and visitors say "there's no better way to see 30a"!

Enjoy the perfect gathering spot in our home’s open and bright main floor family room. This spacious, welcoming area is thoughtfully designed for comfort, making it ideal for movie and game nights, or unwinding together.
Take a dip in our refreshing Neighborhood Pool!
Retreat to our spacious and luxurious Master Bedroom with a Smart TV, dresser and Ensuite Bathroom on the second floor.
Wind down after a long day in our spacious King bathroom, featuring dual sinks for added convenience and a relaxing atmosphere.

We provide a variety boredom-busting games and books, ensuring there’s entertainment for everyone. Whether you’re in the mood for a game night or a relaxing read, you’ll find something to enjoy during your stay.
An unforgettable beach day awaits! With our complimentary beach gear (including beach towels) at your disposal, you’ll have everything you need for a perfect day by the water.
We have an open-concept kitchen, dining, and living area with a smart TV and plenty of board games and books to keep our guests entertained!

Our spacious 3rd Floor Loft Bunk Room provides plenty of room to spread out and relax. With a bright, sunny atmosphere and a smart TV for entertainment, it’s the perfect spot for kids or the whole family to unwind after a day of fun.
Our Queen Bedroom features an ensuite bathrom.
Queen Bathroom Shower and Sink
Entryway to the deck on second floor
First Floor Half Bath

Inlet Beach is part the scenic 30A corridor, known for its pristine white beach and turquoise waters. And usually less crowded than some other beaches in the area. Paddle boarding, beach bonfires, and beach volleyball are popular activities!
We can help you book the perfect beach bonfire. Reach out to us after booking!
Serenity by the Sea is in walking distance to the vibrant 30Avenue Pavilions. The Pavilions feature a variety of restaurant shopping and entertainment options sure to please your whole family!

The brand-new Inlet Beach pedestrian underpass is minutes away, connecting you to Rosemary Beach and the scenic 30A area. This easy access path makes it simple to explore nearby shops, restaurants, and attractions.

The 30A area is packed with incredible cafes and restaurants that showcase local flavors, fresh seafood, and unique culinary twists. We provide a list of our local restaurant recommendations after booking.
Whether you’re heading to Rosemary Beach, Seaside, or any of the other nearby communities, you’ll love the freedom and adventure of biking along this beautiful stretch of Florida’s Gulf Coast.
The beaches along 30A are famous for their soft, sugar-white sands, which are made from pure quartz crystal. This gives the sand a cool feel and a dazzling brightness.
Rosemary Beach Town Center is a vibrant area that offers a unique mix of boutique shopping, gourmet dining, and beautiful architecture, all set against a scenic coastal backdrop.
Sunsets at Inlet Beach are truly amazing, and the perfect spot to unwind and soak in the natural beauty of the Emerald Coast.

description: Panama City Beach is home to this vacation home. The area's natural beauty can be seen at Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach, while Frank Brown Park and Shipwreck Island Waterpark are popular area attractions. Sundog Books and Emerald Coast Mirror Maze are also worth visiting. Jet skiing and kayaking offer great chances to get out on the surrounding water, or you can seek out an adventure with hiking and cycling nearby.
